metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skills — diff review, footgun hunting, rubber-duck debugging, daily standup, bug triage, and a banking-domain glossary.

plugins.name: check-consistency
plugins.description: Review a git diff against inferred repo patterns and universal best practices. Flags inconsistencies, sloppy comments, lazy / over-engineered code, and hardcoded paths before commit.

plugins.name: rubber-duck
plugins.description: Structured rubber-duck debugging — forces articulating the problem properly before any solution is proposed.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Generate a daily standup summary from git activity. Reads git log over a window and produces a 3-bullet Yesterday / Today / Blockers summary.

plugins.name: bank-jargon
plugins.description: Personal banking / software / AI terminology notebook. Auto-triggers on named terms / acronyms / domain concepts and maintains a glossary at ~/.claude/data/bank-jargon/glossary.md.

plugins.name: safe-commit
plugins.description: Commit safety layer — secret scanning, identity verification, and commit hygiene enforcement. Blocks commits containing secrets, sensitive files, hardcoded paths, or merge conflict markers. After a clean commit, reminds the user to run /me:check-consistency.

plugins.name: alert-sounds
plugins.description: Hook-based audio + visual alerts for Claude Code events — distinct sounds, desktop notifications, taskbar flash, and status line colors. Fully configurable per event via hooks/config.json. Installed separately from the `me` bundle (hooks can't live in a skill bundle).

plugins.name: next-step
plugins.description: Tiny UserPromptSubmit hook — injects a `**Next:**` directive into every prompt so Claude ends responses with a copy-pasteable slash command. Standalone alternative to mk-flow's much bigger intent-inject hook. No slash commands of its own.

plugins.name: ship-ready
plugins.description: Whole-repo pre-distribution audit + guided cleanup. Scans everything that would be committed for personal identifiers, secrets, dangling references to gitignored paths, workflow/AI leakage, generated-file slop, dead config/code, and PII; stops with a fix-plan checklist you select from; then applies only the chosen fixes and hands over git/rm commands.

plugins.name: good-ux
plugins.description: Frontend UX auditor and build-time guide. Three modes — scan (whole-repo audit), diff (current changes), and guide (applied while writing UI, offered when relevant work appears and entered only on acceptance) — covering loading/error/empty/success states, forms, graceful degradation, familiarity and complexity laws, accessibility, destructive-action guards, and dark-pattern detection. Reports findings first; applies fixes only on approval (--fix skips the gate; dark patterns are never auto-fixed).

plugins.name: me
plugins.description: Personal Claude Code skills + matching /me:<name> slash commands. Skills under the `me:` namespace, commands as /me:check-consistency, /me:rubber-duck, /me:standup, /me:bank-jargon, /me:safe-commit, /me:ship-ready, /me:good-ux.
